Find the [[Holy Relic]] and bring it back to the [[Sardelac Sanitarium]].

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = prophecies
| profession = necromancer
}}

===Objectives===
* Find the [[Grawl]] that have stolen the relic. Look for them in the fields just north of the [[Sardelac Sanitarium|Sanitarium]].
* Escort [[Necromancer Munne]] and the relic back to the sanitarium. {{sic|"sanitarium" is lowercase here}}
* Return to Necromancer Munne for your reward.

===Reward===
* 200 [[Experience]]
* {{skill icon|Insidious Parasite}}
* {{skill icon|Life Siphon}}
* {{skill icon|Deathly Swarm}}
* {{skill icon|Animate Bone Horror}}

==Walkthrough==
This quest is quite short. Meet Necromancer Munne outside of the Sardelac Sanitarium. She will start heading north, where you have to kill three Grawls. The quest item "Holy Relic" will drop, you have to pick it up and carry it back to Munne. You will gain the reward only by holding the quest item. If you drop it, Munne won't give you the reward.

===Allies===
[[Humans]]

[[Grawl]] (a total of three will [[spawn]])

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Necromancer Munne
:''"So you wish to prove yourself a true Necromancer? Then I have a task for you. A group of '''Grawl''' raided the Sanitarium several days past. We drove them off but not before they carried off a valuable artifact, a '''holy relic''' that [[Mhenlo]] had retrieved from the catacombs. The Grawl were last seen just north of here. I shall accompany you on this mission to evaluate your performance. When you're ready, meet me just outside of the Sanitarium."''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I will undertake this challenge.
| decline = Sounds dangerous. I think I'll pass.
| ask = Meet me outside of the Sanitarium. We will then go and deal with those '''Grawl'''.
}}

===Intermediate dialogue===
:'''Necromancer Munne:''' ''"Now then, let us go retrieve our lost relic. Follow me."''
:'''Necromancer Munne:''' ''"Why don't you carry that relic back to the Sanitarium. I don't like to do the heavy lifting."''
:'''Necromancer Munne:''' ''"Follow me young Necromancer."''
:'''Necromancer Munne:''' ''"This should be far enough. Bring the relic to me. I'll make sure that it gets back to its proper place in the Sanitarium."''

===Reward dialogue===
;Necromancer Munne
:''"With the return of this relic, the inmates of the Sanitarium will sleep easier this night. And it's all thanks to you. You show some real talent for the high art of Necromancy."''

==Notes==
*The three Grawls that spawn with this quest will attack other Grawls that enter their [[aggro]].
